data.name: Whack-a-Vote: Hammering the Polls
data.detailed_description:
Do you have opinions? Do you like to tell people about your opinions till their ears bleed? Wonderful! It sounds like you're ready to exercise your constitutional right to vote!

Now, as 2016 has seen such an unprecedented election cycle, it only seems fitting that our cutting-edge new voting machine technology is revealed to the world to decide between some very colorful candidates!

Complete the sign-in form before entering one of our delightful booths and choose carefully your voting implement. Voting is very important, but also very expensive. A slot machine, with a direct feed straight from the IRS and the Federal Reserve, has been provided to dispense taxpayer funds to power the amazing new Whack-A-Vote machines.

Vote with care, electorate! Every single vote counts, maybe!

About the Team and our Goals:

Back in September a post on r/vive was made asking if people were interested in making VR content. Within hours we had several people respond to it and we further organized ourselves in a discord channel. We had people from all skill levels present but we all shared the same goal, to create content for VR in order to further support the VR community. We organized into smaller teams with each team pursuing a small project. Whack a Vote is the first title to reach completion. We quickly realized that releasing a game as a group would require a legal entity backing us which meant we had to start a company. With that said we hope that this title will provide us with enough funding to establish ourselves as a legitimate company that will be solely VR focused. We understand that this title is small in scope and quirky but we did put our heart into it. If anything the project is providing us with a stepping stone for bigger and better projects to come.

data.short_description: Whack a Vote: Hammering the Polls is a Virtual Reality game that allows you to vote in 2016’s Presidential Election in new innovative ways through the use of various new voting utensils. Shamelessly spend taxpayer money to cast your vote now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7, Windows 8.1 or Windows 10
  • Processador: Intel® i5-4590, AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 970, AMD Radeon™ R9 290 equivalent or better, Video Output: HDMI 1.4, DisplayPort 1.2 or newer
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 250 MB de espaço livre
  • Compatibilidade com R.V.: SteamVR. Room Scale 2m by 1.5m area required

reviews.review: Whack-a-Vote: Hammering the Polls is a wonderfully absurd, highly chaotic VR political satire that works as a perfect 30-minute arcade distraction. Released as a free passion project right before the historic 2016 US Presidential Election, the premise is simple: democracy is apparently a literal game of whack-a-mole, and you must cast your vote by smashing caricatured candidates in the face.Before entering the polling booth, you sign a registration form with a giant crayon, and then you are thrown straight into a fast-paced dexterity test. The gameplay utilizes tracked motion controllers to let you swing distinct voting implements—ranging from standard hammers to ridiculous chunks of meat—at targets popping out of slots. To fund your frantic swinging, a slot machine directly fed by the IRS dispenses taxpayer money right in front of you. While the hit detection is slightly floaty and the game lacks haptic controller rumble, the sheer mechanical panic makes it hilarious to mess around with. It features a total lack of an in-game pause menu, but as a completely free-to-play time capsule of 2016 internet humor that avoids bloating your showcase with tracking achievements, it is well worth half an hour of your time.
